import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int next, to, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge(int next, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 100010;
    static final int MAXM = 2000020;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int edge_count = 1;
    static int total_nodes;
    static List<Integer>[] adj_list = new List[MAXN];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, long cost) {
        edges[++edge_count] = new Edge(head[u], v, cap, cost);
        head[u] = edge_count;
        edges[++edge_count] = new Edge(head[v], u, 0, -cost);
        head[v] = edge_count;
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        static int[] current_head = new int[MAXN];
        static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
        static long[] distance = new long[MAXN];
        static long[] potential = new long[MAXN];

        static class PQNode implements Comparable<PQNode> {
            int id;
            long priority;
            PQNode(int i, long p) {
                id = i;
                priority = p;
            }
            public int compareTo(PQNode other) {
                return Long.compare(priority, other.priority);
            }
        }

        static PriorityQueue<PQNode> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();

        static boolean shortestPath(int src, int dst) {
            Arrays.fill(distance, 1, total_nodes + 1, INF);
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) {
                current_head[i] = head[1];
            }
            distance[dst] = 0;
            pq.add(new PQNode(dst, 0));

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int u = pq.poll().id;
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;

                for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                    int v = edges[i].to;
                    long w = potential[u] + edges[i ^ 1].cost - potential[v];
                    if (edges[i ^ 1].cap > 0 && distance[u] + w < distance[v]) {
                        distance[v] = distance[u] + w;
                        pq.add(new PQNode(v, distance[v]));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; ++i) {
                potential[i] = Math.min(potential[i] + distance[i], INF);
            }

            if (!visited[src]) return false;
            Arrays.fill(visited, 1, total_nodes + 1, false);
            return true;
        }

        static int augment(int u, int dst, int flow) {
            if (u == dst || flow == 0) return flow;
            int pushed = 0;
            visited[u] = true;

            for (int i = current_head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                if (edges[i].cap > 0) {
                    int v = edges[i].to;
                    int f;
                    if (!visited[v] && potential[v] + edges[i].cost == potential[u] &&
                        (f = augment(v, dst, Math.min(flow, edges[i].cap))) > 0) {
                        edges[i].cap -= f;
                        edges[i ^ 1].cap += f;
                        pushed += f;
                        flow -= f;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }

            visited[u] = false;
            return pushed;
        }

        static int max_flow = 0;
        static long min_cost = 0;

        static void process(int src, int dst) {
            while (shortestPath(src, dst)) {
                int f = augment(src, dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                max_flow += f;
                min_cost += (long)f * potential[src];
            }
        }
    }

    static int source_node = 1, sink_node = 2, n, m, k, c, d;

    static int getNode(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void build(int t) {
        total_nodes += n;

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            for (int v : adj_list[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                    connect(getNode(t, u), getNode(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2L * p - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            connect(getNode(t, u), getNode(t + 1, u), Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        connect(getNode(t + 1, 1), sink_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c * (t + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        k = scanner.nextInt();
        c = scanner.nextInt();
        d = scanner.nextInt();
        total_nodes = n + 2;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            int a = scanner.nextInt();
            connect(source_node, getNode(0, a), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            adj_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = scanner.nextInt();
            int v = scanner.nextInt();
            adj_list[u].add(v);
            adj_list[v].add(u);
        }

        connect(getNode(0, 1), sink_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; ++i) {
            build(i);
        }

        MinCostMaxFlow.process(source_node, sink_node);
        System.out.println(MinCostMaxFlow.min_cost);
    }
}
